items.title: Uttargaya confirms 655 deaths linked to Rasuwa Flood
items.summary: Kathmandu, November 8 The number of people killed or missing in the flood that struck Uttargaya Rural Municipality in Rasuwa on August 26 has been established. Of those reported missing across the rural municipality, only 11 have been identified, while death registration proceedings are underway for 655 people. items.title: Disaster authority publishes verified details of 2,294 people missing in Bhotekoshi floods
items.summary: Kathmandu, November 8 The National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA) has published verified details of 2,294 people from 32 districts who went missing in the Bhotekoshi floods. The authority said it had released only the details verified by the District Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Committees in the 32 districts. items.title: From flood-hit areas to crime scenes, Nepal’s police dogs sniff out vital clues
items.summary: One of 107 dogs in the police force, Leo located two bodies and human remains during a 20-day search after the Bhotekoshi floods.
